calls.title: Circle + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The meeting centered on assessing GrowthBook as a self-hosted feature flagging and experimentation alternative to LaunchDarkly. Key concerns included LaunchDarkly's pricing and reliability, specifically a notable nine-hour outage that affected client authentication. The team seeks to self-host for better SLA control and cost management, given their existing contract has six months remaining. GrowthBook demonstrated feature parity with LaunchDarkly through diverse flag types and advanced rollout strategies, including targeted and percentage rollouts. Additionally, GrowthBook offers integration of experimentation with metrics for data-driven decisions, while pricing discussions highlighted that GrowthBook's costs are substantially higher than current spending on LaunchDarkly. Finally, the team is interested in self-hosting to enhance data governance and reliability, supported by Terraform integration and operational workflows.
calls.keywords: feature flags, pricing model, LaunchDarkly alternatives, self-hosting, gradual rollout, experimentation
